Join us for an evening of presentations and course information. You will have the chance to meet current students and course leaders and to take a tour of our exceptional facilities.
Cleeve School Sixth Form provides a vibrant and successful environment in which to develop your potential. The highest standards of teaching are combined with outstanding levels of pastoral care, advice and guidance to ensure that you are fully challenged and supported to do the very best you can.

Values and Ethos
OUR VALUES Aspiring, Collaborating, Transforming. OUR MISSIONTransforming Lives, Creating Opportunities and Inspiring Futures.
Through our daily mission, we will inspire a sense of joy, happiness and curiosity, so that everyone is inspired to flourish, grow and learn within a highly aspirational environment. We will collectively achieve extraordinary things.
At the heart of our vision is collaboration and a partnership of community-focused schools providing an exceptional quality of ‘all-through’ education.
Our knowledge-rich, sequential curriculum will challenge, empower and liberate all students in readiness for a rapidly changing world of work.
Doors of opportunity will open for every student, enriching their learning, stimulating their talents and inspiring dreams for their futures.
We will be a Centre of Excellence for Teaching, Learning and Training, attracting, growing and retaining the very best practitioners.
Prospective families will select us because of our values, standards and expertise, inspired by our diversity, quality of care and unrelenting, daily ambition.
Our buildings and environment will reflect our ambitions and our culture will be one of belonging, exceptional self discipline and respect for others.
We will be a beacon of aspiration, hope and pride for our community, shining a light on the transformative powers of a fully inclusive school, that dares to break the mould.
The Historian AJP Taylor wrote that ‘the future is a land without maps’. As pioneers, we are relishing the journey ahead.

2030 Vision and Strategy
The 2030 Vision and Strategy captures the seven-year plan that will lead us on our next stage of very exciting and exhilarating development. As well as celebrating our last five years of growth and successes, the ‘2030 Vision’ document is full of sky-high ambition and defines and celebrates our identity, as a school that wants to be one of the very best in the land in a broad range of areas. A school that wants to disrupt the ‘status quo’ for education so that our students, from our community, regardless of who they are or their backgrounds, receive a ‘world class’ experience of education, which is inspired by collaboration, rooted in high aspiration and which provides a truly transformative experience.
READ THE 2030 VISION & STRATEGY DOCUMENT

Fundraising and sponsorship
Enrichment Fund
The School is very proud of the wide range of extra-curricular enrichment activities that are available to our students. We believe these provide an opportunity for every student to achieve their potential and develop valuable life skills for the future.
In order to support our enrichment programme, we ask parents/guardians and the local community to consider making a regular donation to the Enrichment Fund.
If you wish to contribute you can do so either by setting up a regular standing order with your bank or by making a one-off donation by cheque made payable to 'Cleeve School Enrichment Fund.'
If you are planning to make a donation to the Cleeve School Enrichment Fund, please complete the Voluntary Contribution Mandate and if applicable the Gift Aid Declaration Form.
One-off donation towards our major projects
If you wish to make a one-off donation and direct it to help support and fund one of our current projects below, please make a one-off donation by bank transfer to the Cleeve School Fund Account (Sort Code: 30-95-72 / Account Number: 27997668) or cheque, payable to 'Cleeve School Fund Account.'
3G Artificial Multi-Purpose Astro Pitch
Tennis Dome
Corporate Sponsorship
If you run your own business you may find this method an attractive and cost effective way of supporting Cleeve. We will make every effort to ensure that the support/partnership of the Sponsor is highlighted across our online channels, parent newsletters, press promotions and school projects. Please email partnerships@cleeveschool.com for more information.
Why not advertise your business in our Parent Newsletter?
Our ever popular, Parent Newsletter (Cleeve Calling) is circulated to almost 1,500 parents/guardians, each half-term. With hundreds of rural businesses, industry experts, sponsors and rural organisations close by, this newsletter provides an excellent opportunity to advertise to your target audience.

pageCache.text:
WELCOME FROM THE EXECUTIVE HEAD
I am delighted to welcome you to Cleeve School.
This is an extremely exciting time to be joining our flourishing Cleeve community. We are a school that is rapidly moving from strength to strength, and our intention is to be one of the very best schools, not just in the local area, but beyond. We are very proudly a school for all, providing excellence for all, and as a core value we believe in creating daily transformational moments for our students, from their classroom experiences, to their personal development to a very broad range of enrichment opportunities.
We value academic success, and we expect many of our students to progress to some of the very best universities in the country. Equally, we also have excellent pathways to the best apprenticeships and training opportunities in our area, including within cyber and technology.
We strongly believe in enriching our students’ lives through a broad range of extra-curricular activities, trips and events, so that their school days are memorable, happy and formative, fully preparing them for the exciting world beyond school.
As a resource-rich school, we invest in more staff and therefore achieve smaller class sizes. What might appear as a large school on the outside, is shaped into much smaller communities within, and our College structure is a key part of this. As a Teacher Training Lead School, we place a very large value on developing our staff.
Our Pastoral Team is second to none and new students are supported by very strong pastoral structures including via a specialist Year 7 team.
Our Ofsted-rated 'Outstanding' Sixth Form Centre of Excellence acts as a beacon for some of the very best teachers around who, at a time of recruitment challenges within the profession, join us so that they can teach students from Year 7 through to pre-university in Year 13. From the moment they arrive, I want your children to aspire to be in our Sixth Form, proud of what they are achieving and inspired by the exciting curriculum journey through Key Stages 3 and 4 and feeling a sense of joy about educational opportunities.
Cleeve School has recently been selected as a pathfinding Cyber School Hub and designated as Cyber School of the Year at the National Cyber awards. As well as attracting significant funding, this means that we benefit from strong partnerships with Cyber Security organisations, including the National Cyber Security Centre. We are ‘charged’ with ensuring that we help to create future experts in such a relevant employment area. This is the kind of challenge that inspires us!
At Cleeve, we value Modern Foreign Languages and the Arts subjects, whilst also enjoying very strong reputations in Music, Drama and Dance. Within our main atrium, we have some of the very best Science resources in the country, and English and Mathematics mastery underpins our spinal curriculum throughout all year groups. We love what we do and we are very proud of what we offer because our size brings a huge choice of opportunities.
We are building something very special here at Cleeve and I want your child to be part of our exciting journey. Our mission is to create a school that is exceptional, which genuinely creates a sense of joy for learning, and our values of Aspiring, Collaborating and Transforming drive everything we do.
As a parent myself, I know how important the transfer process is between primary and secondary school, and we continue to review to ensure that this transition period is as supportive and helpful as possible. Each year we hold three Year 7 Induction Days during the summer term and a residential for all students to attend during their first academic year with us.
If you value high quality, broad opportunity and an ambitious vision for what education should be, with wellbeing and happiness at the centre of everything we do, then come and join our thriving family. I very much look forward to working with you in close partnership.

Careers Programme - BUSINESS & Employers
At Cleeve, we have cultivated strong and mutually beneficial working relationships with employers that significantly enhance our students' experience of work and their future prospects.
Through ongoing collaboration, local businesses and industry leaders actively participate in our careers programme, offering real world insight and practical skills that align with current market demands.
This might look like:
- Exhibiting at our annual careers fair
- Delivering an inspiring lecture or assembly
- Supporting a classroom project or activity
- Taking part in mock interviews
- Offering a Year 10 or Year 12 work experience placement
- Taking part in our STEM and Cyber activity days
We would love to hear from you if you'd like to support our careers programme.
To discuss any of these possibilities, please complete the following form and a member of the Careers Team will be in touch
Work Experience
Work experience is vital to young people at school, college, and as they enter the labour market. They get first hand experience of the work place and an insight into jobs and sectors which increases their confidence and employability skills. They also gain experience in building their CVs and networking with professionals.
Placements are a great idea for employers. They help you give back by giving a young person an opportunity. It could potentially find you a brilliant future employee, and they will help you give your current employees some management training.

Careers Programme - Statutory INFORMATION
At Cleeve School, we are committed to providing our students with a comprehensive Careers Programme of careers advice, guidance and information to help them decide their next steps at Post 16 and Post 18.
We believe that providing good careers guidance and preparing students for the 'working world' is an important role in our curriculum, raising aspirations and opportunities available to them is key within their learning.
How do we assess the impact of our provision?
The impact of individual encounters is predominantly assessed via student feedback. We monitor access to opportunities and the uptake by different groups of students. The overall effectiveness of the careers programme at Cleeve is assessed using the Careers and Enterprise Future Skills Questionnaire. We also assess the provision through the use of Compass+ which allows us to evaluate our current provisions and plan for future activities.
Indicators of impact include:
- The number/percentage of students completing a work experience placement
- The number/percentage of students who have Post-16 provision in place by the summer
- Post-16 and Post-18 destination data
- Gatsby Benchmark indicators met
Provider Access Legislation
All pupils in years 8 to 13 are entitled:
- to find out about technical education qualifications and apprenticeship opportunities as part of a careers programme which provides information on the full range of education and training options available at each transition point.
- to hear from a range of local providers about the opportunities they offer, including technical education and apprenticeships - through options events, assemblies, group discussion and taster events.
- to understand how to make applications for the full range of academic and technical courses.
